about_the_game:
Connect to the Other Side, Listen to Her Heart

One day, you discover a mysterious communication interface. It doesn't connect to this world, but leads to a distant shore. A message from an unknown time and space links you with her. You become her sole confidant, a secret presence from "outside her world."

Listen to the Past, Influence the Future

Through ongoing conversations, you'll gradually delve into her world: a fantastical land steeped in ancient legends, flashing blades, and hidden perils. Listen as she recounts her experiences and shares her current predicament—she seems ensnared in a complex web of fate, tightly bound to another's destiny by an unspeakable power. When she faces choices and hesitates, your responses and advice become the compass guiding her path, subtly altering the course of her future.

Await the Echo, Feel the Bond

The world she inhabits isn't always calm. When crises arise in her reality, she needs time to confront them. At these moments, your communication link might temporarily fall silent, requiring you to patiently await her next reply. Each wait deepens the invisible bond connecting you across the veil.

"When your gaze falls upon this missive, perhaps she feels a distant gaze from another world."

Game Features:

  • Unique Interface: Presented in an Eastern fantasy style, driving the story through pure text interaction.

  • Real-time (Asynchronous) Communication: Experience the realism of conversing with a character from another world, including moments of waiting for her reply.

  • Deep Story & Character Development: Explore a tale steeped in Eastern fantasy and forge a profound connection with the heroine.

  • Choices with Deep Impact: Every decision you make can lead to different story branches and endings.

  • Gradually Unveiling Mysteries: As the story progresses, unravel the truths behind the connection, the "Mirror," and her intertwined destiny with "him."

Please Note: This game contains adult themes and complex emotional depictions. Player choices will significantly impact the story's progression and final outcome.

Are you ready to receive the signal from the other side and intervene in this cross-world game of fate?

This demo features the [Prologue / Opening Chapter / First Chapter] of the game. You will be able to experience the beginning of the story, the core character interaction mechanics, and our unique "advisor/influencer" gameplay. Through this [Prologue/Opening Chapter/First Chapter], you can get an initial understanding of the game's world, main characters, and the crucial role you will play in the narrative.

The full version of the game will feature a more expansive storyline, additional choice branches, multiple endings, and deeper character development. If you enjoy the content of this [Prologue/Opening Chapter/First Chapter], please be sure to add the full game to your wishlist and experience the complete adventure upon its release!
